heard: Nearly 200 men at the Alamo faced a blood-red flag. In 1836, William Travis answered surrender demands with cannon fire. For 13 days, they waited for reinforcements that never came. At dawn on March 6, thousands of troops breached the walls. Final massacre was over in only 90 minutes. Six weeks later, the Texian army won in 18 minutes. They remembered the men who face that blood-red flag.
